correctness.rationale: The dodecahedron has 20 explicit vertices, 30 equal edges and 10 antipodal axes. Ten great circles are pairwise transverse with no triple concurrence, so 90 intersection points and 92 hemispherical sign chambers; exact sign tests label all chambers, classify 20 hexagon normal cells (6 section sides), 60 triangles (8 sides), 12 pentagons (10 sides). Spherical excess with angles α=acos(1/3), β=acos(√5/3) yields all three positive areas, area sum 4π. Mean 30β/π independently follows from edge-crossing probability β/π. Independent written exact Q(√5) sign/corner enumeration reproduces the full census.
